Generated terminal assets live here; run npm install from the repository root.
The prepare script copies @xterm/xterm 6.0.0 and @xterm/addon-fit 0.11.0,
including both MIT license notices. No browser CDN requests or bundler are used.
Do not edit generated assets. Change package.json and rerun npm install to update.
Run npm install before building a Python wheel so these assets are packaged.
